ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $ \angle AOD=60^\circ$, $ \angle BOC$ is a right angle, and OC bisects $ \angle AOD$. What is the measure of $ \angle BOD$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
$\because$ OC bisects $\angle AOD$,\\
$\therefore \angle COD=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOD$,\\
$\because \angle AOD=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle COD=30^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle BOC$ is a right angle,\\
$\therefore \angle BOC=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle BOC-\angle COD=90^\circ-30^\circ=\boxed{60^\circ}$.
